idea-plugin.name: Review Atlas Bridge
idea-plugin.description: Thin shell for code-review atlases: renders a single-file HTML flow map in a JCEF tool window and jumps to the exact file:line when a code anchor is clicked. The HTML is the only source of truth and is re-read from disk on every request. Jump works through three independent layers: JS bridge, CEF request intercept and a loopback /jump endpoint (external browsers included).
